result.description:
Your new company     
 Our client is a well-established and growing pet care and boarding business dedicated to providing exceptional care for dogs and cats in a safe, comfortable, and professional environment. With a strong focus on customer service, animal welfare, and operational excellence, they are seeking an experienced Resort Manager to lead their Sunshine Coast facility and oversee the day-to-day operations of the resort. 
   Your new role     
 As the Resort Manager, you will be responsible for the successful operation of the facility, leading a team of animal care professionals while ensuring the highest standards of pet welfare, customer service, and commercial performance. 
   
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Leading, coaching, and managing resort staff, including rostering, recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance management 
 Ensuring the health, wellbeing, and comfort of all animals through appropriate feeding, exercise, hygiene, and husbandry practices 
 Delivering exceptional customer service and creating positive client experiences to drive customer loyalty 
 Managing resort administration, including bookings, check-ins/check-outs, reporting, inventory management, and financial transactions 
 Monitoring budgets, labour costs, and operational performance to achieve business targets and KPIs 
 Coordinating veterinary care, medication administration, health monitoring, and incident reporting processes when required 
 Maintaining the presentation, cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness of the entire facility, vehicles, and equipment 
 Ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, company procedures, and animal welfare standards 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 You will be an energetic and people-focused leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in creating exceptional experiences for both customers and their pets. You will possess strong commercial acumen, excellent organisational skills, and a genuine passion for leading teams and delivering operational excellence. 
   
 You will bring: 
 
 Previous leadership or management experience within animal care, hospitality, tourism, retail, accommodation, veterinary, or service-based environments 
 Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing performance, and building positive workplace cultures 
 Strong operational management skills, including rostering, workforce planning, budgeting, KPI management, and resource allocation 
 Experience overseeing customer-facing operations and delivering exceptional customer service outcomes 
 Strong administration and computer skills, with the ability to manage reporting, inventory, financial transactions, and day-to-day business operations 
 Financial awareness and experience managing labour costs, budgets, revenue targets, and operational expenditure 
 Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise competing demands 
 A proactive, hands-on management style and willingness to lead by example across all areas of the resort
